alias_updates.description: See user alias object. For more information on old_alias_name, new_alias_name, and alias_label, refer to User aliases.

output.description: The Braze response; `message` is `success` when the request was accepted.

update_user_aliases.notes: The REST API key needs the users.alias.update permission.

merge_users.title: Merge users
merge_users.description: Merge one user into another user. Braze REST endpoint POST /users/merge.

merge_updates.description: An object array. Each object should contain an identifier_to_merge object and an identifier_to_keep object, which should each reference a user either by external_id, user_alias, phone, or email.

output.description: The Braze response; `message` is `success` when the request was accepted.

merge_users.notes: The REST API key needs the users.merge permission.
